name: amplify-migrations-root
description: MikroORM-style migrations for AWS Amplify Data (Gen 2)

scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test
scripts.pack:local: mkdir -p ./.tmp/pack && pnpm -C packages/core pack --pack-destination ../../.tmp/pack && pnpm -C packages/cli pack --pack-destination ../../.tmp/pack && pnpm -C packages/cdk pack --pack-destination ../../.tmp/pack
scripts.release: pnpm verify && pnpm pack:local && node ./scripts/publish-tarballs.mjs --tag next
scripts.release:dry-run: pnpm verify && pnpm pack:local && node ./scripts/publish-tarballs.mjs --tag next --dry-run
